source_host_record: NCBI Datasets maps GCA_019661745.1 (Mollicutes bacterium PWAP) to assembly ASM1966174v1, SAMN19298836 and PRJNA646234. Pimentel et al. (2022) explicitly names ASM1966174v1 in Data availability and identifies the sampled host as Limacina rangii in title and methods; dissected guts of nine pteropods pooled as three site samples were coassembled. BioSample host is Limacina antarctica and BioProject title uses Limacina helicina antarctica gut contents. Display follows the source-publication identification while preserving this archive difference. WoRMS currently accepts Limacina rangii (AphiaID719583) and Limacina antarctica (509607) separately; do not silently treat the archive name as a verified synonym.

NCBI Datasets report links GCA_024244685.1, isolate Cca_4, SAMN13632625, explicit host Cancris carmenensis, derived source SAMN10181160, PRJNA503328. Woehle2022 Materials and Methods assigns PRJNA503328 to metagenomic datasets from foraminifera; Fig4 explicitly includes Cancris carmenensis bacterial communities. Exact genome-to-host evidence is archive metadata, corroborated at project/sample-organism level by publication. Foraminifera and WoRMS AphiaID521629 confirmed by NOAA COPEPEDIA. Host is a protist, not an animal; broader isolation_source marine sediment does not supersede explicit host.
